text_block_list.text:
One day while walking with Transcend,
someone who seemed to know her called out to us.

text_block_list.name: Tran's Acquaintance
text_block_list.text:
I caught wind of a little rumor...
About 'Yone-san's Roasted Carrots' down in the shopping district.
choice_data_list: (Huh? Wait, isn't Yone-san supposed to be...)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Good old Yone-san. She always gives extra carrots—
the mother of the shopping district~.

text_block_list.name: Tran's Acquaintance
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. About that Yone-san... lately,
he's suddenly gotten super stylish, right?
...Apparently, it's 'cause he got hooked on idols.

text_block_list.name: Tran's Acquaintance
text_block_list.text:
And! That led to a fight with the old man.
...So for a while, we might not be getting any bonus grilled carrots on the side.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, mhm.
I see, I see.

text_block_list.name: Tran's Acquaintance
text_block_list.text:
"Pretty good info, wasn't it? So!
As a finder's fee, there's something I wanna ask you in return—"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"—Before we get into that, though,
I'd like you to take a look at this too~... There."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
""Right into the interview! ...Nah, let's start with some small talk~.
...I heard, Yone-san!
About what inspired you to start dressing up stylishly!""

text_block_list.name: Yone-san
text_block_list.text: "What!?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"It's because of that idol who debuted recently, right~?
I totally get it. You wanna look pretty for your fave~."

text_block_list.name: Yone-san
text_block_list.text: ""A-Ah... Right! That's it exactly!""

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Looking good! That orange watch is lovely too!
...Seeing his wife look so pretty must've made your old man really happy, right?"

text_block_list.name: Yone-san
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, come on. There's no way.
Not at all, not a chance. He just stared at me the whole time without saying a word."

text_block_list.name: Yone-san
text_block_list.text:
"You used to tell me,
'Carrot orange really suits a cheerful girl like you'...
...Though I'm completely an old lady now, aren't I?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: —Actually, about a week ago, Pops shielded Yone-san when she almost got hit by a bicycle, ya see.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: And Yone-san fell for the old man all over again, while the old man fell for how pretty she looked...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Conclusion! All that idol stuff is just a maiden's bashfulness!
The two of them are right in the middle of falling in love all over again!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: If anything, now's your chance to aim for a bonus!

text_block_list.name: Tran's Acquaintance
text_block_list.text: A-Are you serious...?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. So, what that means is~...
We're in a situation where I actually provided you with useful info.
In other words, the one who deserves a reward is... me-♡

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hey... You've got something interesting on you right now, don't you?
That bonus item you got at the flea market yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Tran's Acquaintance
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Why do you want that...?
I mean, are you seriously fine with something like that?

text_block_list.name: Tran's Acquaintance
text_block_list.text:
“A camcorder that captures danger,”
“A doll that awakens your escape instinct”...
...Aren't these super suspicious?

text_block_list.name: Tran's Acquaintance
text_block_list.text:
There's no manual or anything,
so it really is a total "unknown"...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: An un, known...?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: I definitely want it... ♡
choice_data_list: Where did all that competence from earlier go...?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "Hah! A special present for you, straight into the gutter!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
A mystery item!
An unknown where anything could happen!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: It's the ultimate! Gives me chills all over~!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, which one should I get~?
Trainie, which one do you think is better?
choice_data_list: "A doll that awakens the flight instinct."

text_block_list.text: They both seem suspicious... but if forced to choose, I pick the 'Danger-Projecting Camcorder.'

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh? Awesome! Look, Trainie!
It's totally showing DANGER!

Looking closer, next to the rusty sign we were photographing, it read:
"Deteriorated. Danger of Falling!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
See? Pretty cool, huh!
Let's project some other things too, Trai-chan!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, that's it? It just says 'DANGER'
on the video monitor.
choice_data_list: Huh... is that what it is?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Aaah. Well, that's how it ends, huh.
Bummer~.
They both seem suspicious... but if forced to choose, I pick the 'Doll That Awakens Survival Instincts.'

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Aha! Look, Trai-chan!
It's seriously chasing me everywhere!
choice_data_list: A doll from a horror movie!?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, this concept is seriously genius, isn't it?!
Heheh! Time to run awayyy!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I can't catch it at aaaall...!
How is a doll outrunning an Umamusume!? What's going on~?!

...After that, Transcend managed to catch the running doll,
left completely exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
No, no.
If I miss this, a chance like this won't—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan...
...Don't you like me just a little too much?
choice_data_list: I have a duty and a mission to protect you!
I have a duty and a mission to protect you!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Truly refreshing.
Alright, I'll back down this time... for this time, okay?
